finding_detail: The catalog's Lean formalization proves the qualitative theorem (NLA.MF24.no_uniform_comparison, arbitrarily_large_ratios) and a weaker quantitative bound (2/3)sqrt(m) at t=m with conservative denominator t^2+m; the headline (4/5)sqrt(m), the t^2+m-1 denominator, and Corollary 3 (all-dimension padding, liminf C_N/N^{1/4} >= 1) are explicitly outside the formalized scope on both the tree page and the catalog page. Both sides agree on the scope boundary: an honest scope limit, not a verification-credit gap. No route dies.

paper_quote: For every integer m >= 2 and real t > 1, the weighted shifts X = X_{m,t} and Y = Y_{m,t} ... satisfy X ~_{sip} Y. ... ||p_m(X)||_2 >= t^2 sqrt(m), ||p_m(Y)||_2 <= t^2 + m - 1. ... ratio >= (4/5) sqrt(m) -> infinity (t = m). Corollary 3: C_N >= sqrt(floor(sqrt(N)) - 1), N >= 9.
